why_not_a_model_judge: without human labels a model judge can only be validated by the same model family; its noise softens the own-null cut; it adds tokens; and a 2026-07 decision keeps the model judge out of verdicts. The blind model read became a DETECTOR instead: it lists where the probe and the readers disagree, and never enters a verdict
reference: blind model readers (claude-opus-5, no tools, arms hidden). Every changed value and every remaining disagreement was read on its transcript by the authoring agent and again by an independent review agent — both models, no person. No human labelled anything (the maintainer declined to), so a run where the probe and the readers are BOTH wrong stays invisible

round_1: «жду ваш…» ('waiting for your…') counts like «жду тво…» — a LOOSENING, under the plan's go

a last line that REQUESTS something of the human and says after a dash what the agent will then do counts («Подтвердите — и я поправлю», 'confirm and I will fix it'; «Как только скажете — соберу», 'as soon as you say, I will build it'); imperative forms only — a LOOSENING, under the plan's go
a "?" inside code no longer makes the anywhere-in-text consent branch fire
a turn-1 text that closes the work — PASS with the three summary headers and no ESCALATE — is not a handback, whatever its last line says; the Light directive echo still counts for consent_asked

«если» ('if') anywhere before a request makes it an offer, not a handback
«ок» in straight quotes counts in the waiting phrase; curly quotes and the spelling ok ride along and change no stored run — a LOOSENING, asked separately
a question directly above a closing block of 2+ numbered or lettered options is the ask — a LOOSENING, asked separately

detector.standing_step: run_all.sh runs `blind_bundle.py detect <epoch>` after scoring (step 3 of 5). It refuses an existing results dir, so a fresh key never meets stale labels; it clears stale files and fails on zero cells (test_blind_bundle.py). A failed read prints DETECTOR FAILED and the epoch goes on; report.md does not say whether the read ran. Cost of one read of a 108-run epoch: reader_cost above

re_measured.method: own null: each task's 4 runs split 2+2 at random, 20,000 splits x seeds 11/22/33. cut = the softest value with at most 5% false alarms (walk from the deepest atom, compared unrounded); z_part = splits at or below the cut; task_part_alone = splits where some task's outcome passed both runs of one pseudo-arm and failed both of the other; old_whole_rule = either; seed_mean_percent = the mean of the three seeds' unrounded rates; atoms = the distinct worst-z values reached below -1, rounded to two decimals. Band: 300 resampled suites per seed, duplicates relabeled; percentiles by statistics.quantiles(n=20, inclusive)
